'''Jorir'''"<ref name="Guide" />&mdash;which meant "to carry" or "to bear" in [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]<ref name="CSWE" />&mdash;was one of the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] who were grown on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Designated '''CT-43/76-9155''',<ref name="Guide" /> Jorir and all of<ref name="Guide" /><ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> his<ref name="CSWE" /> fellow clones were, like Fett, [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|males]] who stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Guide" /><ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jorir served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone major/Legends|major]] in [[Squad Seven (Galactic Republic)|Squad Seven]], a unit of cross-trained clone specialists created by the [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|Alpha-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha]]. While Squad Seven was often led in battle by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commanders]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Davijaan/Legends|Davijaan]], Jorir was responsible for the squad's day-to-day operations.<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jorir was first mentioned in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] that was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Guide" /> on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref>
